description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a "small" type Whisper model across different training epochs. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with a displayed range from 25.0 to 42.5, featuring tick marks at intervals of 2.5. Four lines are plotted on the graph, all colored orange. The line for "small AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circular markers; it begins at epoch 0 with a WER of approximately 35.6 and exhibits a steady decline, ending at epoch 6 with a value of approximately 30.5. The line representing "small AdaLoRA_int8" is a solid line with square markers, which starts at epoch 0 at approximately 30.1 and steadily decreases across the x-axis, finishing at epoch 6 near 25.1. The "small int4" line is a dashed line with circular markers; it starts at epoch 0 near 35.6, rises to a peak at epoch 2 with a value of approximately 42.1, and then steadily declines to end at epoch 6 near 31.5. Finally, the "small int8" line is a dashed line with square markers that begins at epoch 0 near 30.1, increases slightly to a peak at epoch 2 near 33.7, declines to a low point at epoch 5 near 25.4, and ends with a slight rise at epoch 6 to approximately 25.9.
